From sleek frontends in React and Next.js to scalable backends in Node.js and Python, I enjoy solving problems end-to-end. Whether it’s deploying with Terraform, scaling with Redis, or mentoring teammates, I’m passionate about creating software that’s fast, reliable, and impactful.

footer.brandTagline: From concept to cloud - I ship it
footer.brandDescription: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience specializing in JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, and the MERN stack. Skilled in building scalable web applications, architecting cloud-native backends, and integrating payment systems. Passionate about delivering high-impact solutions and mentoring teams to achieve technical excellence.

price-auditing-backend.description: Retail price auditing for a US retailer, driven from a mobile app in the aisle. Designed the backend from scratch: over 2 million records per run pulled from an external feed, queued through Redis and written in parallel by Node.js worker threads, then served back paginated and queryable. Node.js, Express, TypeScript and TypeORM on AWS ECS Fargate, with Terraform-managed infrastructure and Datadog logging.
price-auditing-backend.imageAlt: Architecture diagram of the retail price auditing backend: external feed to Redis queue to Node.js worker pool to batch insert, on AWS ECS Fargate

recurring-donations-platform.description: Recurring donations and payments platform for a direct client. Built scheduled recurring transactions, with authentication, storage and edge functions on Supabase and a Next.js and TypeScript front end. Client and product name withheld.

playertotals.description: Live sports statistics platform covering NBA, NFL and MLB, with scores and stats refreshed every 5 minutes. Built on Node.js and TypeScript with Redis queues and MongoDB for high-throughput data processing.
playertotals.imageAlt: Architecture diagram of the PlayerTotals real-time platform: scheduled game data extraction, Redis queue, Node.js and MongoDB API, React live stats dashboard

memberstore.description: One storefront serving multiple independent merchants, each selling under their own brand. Stripe handles payments, merchant onboarding and webhook reconciliation behind a KeystoneJS and GraphQL API on MongoDB, with a Next.js and TypeScript front end.
memberstore.imageAlt: Architecture diagram of the Memberstore multi-merchant storefront: Next.js frontend, GraphQL API on KeystoneJS, Stripe payments and onboarding, and webhook event handling

civasource.description: AI-assisted product matching for a supply marketplace. Extracts up to 1,000 products per minute using asyncio with Redis caching, behind a FastAPI service with authentication.
civasource.imageAlt: Architecture diagram of the CivaSource data pipeline: concurrent source scrapers, Redis queue, AI product matching engine and FastAPI services

safety-compliance-platform.description: Safety checklists and compliance workflows running across multiple industrial sites, with a multi-site audit trail. Moved monolithic APIs to serverless microservices on AWS Lambda with Terraform and cut infrastructure cost by around 30 percent. Directed the team across frontend architecture and cloud infrastructure. Client and product name withheld.
safety-compliance-platform.imageAlt: Architecture diagram of the safety compliance platform: React microservices frontend, API layer, AWS Lambda compliance logic and multi-site reporting

real-time-gaming-platform.description: Real-time gaming platform. Built JavaScript bot libraries and WebSocket connections for in-game bot behavior and communication, plus the UI and command libraries used to control them. Client and product name withheld.

tradefundrr.description: Trading education platform with an integrated CRM used by its own sales team. Contributed core features, API testing and sprint delivery in an agile team. Python, Flask, Django and React.

autotempest.description: Car search across many listing sites at once, filtered in a single form. Built the responsive React front end and the REST API that queries scraped listings out of MySQL.
autotempest.imageAlt: Screenshot of the AutoTempest home page showing the aggregated used car search form

points-app.description: Customer loyalty scheme where points convert into mobile top-up codes. Built the redemption flow and payment processing on Node.js, React and MySQL.

al-khair-traders-pos.description: Replaced a paper process for a wholesale trader: products, suppliers, purchases, sales, returns and quotations in one system, with role-based permissions down to the module level. Node.js, Express and TypeORM behind React with TanStack Query, including JWT authentication, versioned migrations and generated API documentation.

deployment-tool.description: Final year project that removes the hand translation step between Couchbase and Firebase: it converts N1QL queries into Firebase Cloud Functions and deploys them.

freelance.title: Freelance Full-Stack Developer
freelance.summary: Building a recurring donations and payments platform for a direct client, end to end.
responsibilities: Building a recurring donations and payments platform for a direct client, working directly with them on scope, architecture and releases
Designed scheduled recurring transaction handling with retry, idempotency and reconciliation logic so a failed charge never double-bills a supporter
Built authentication, row-level security, storage and Deno edge functions on Supabase with PostgreSQL behind them
Implemented the front end in Next.js App Router and TypeScript, server-rendered, with form validation and typed API contracts
Set up the cron-driven scheduler that runs recurring charges and writes an auditable transaction history
Own delivery end to end, from requirements and architecture through deployment and client communication

xavor.title: Senior Software Engineer
xavor.summary: Designed the backend of a retail price auditing product from scratch, for a US retailer, on AWS.
responsibilities: Designed the backend for a retail price auditing product from scratch, working directly with the US client and under experienced technical leadership
Processed and cached over 2 million records per run from an external data feed, using scheduled cron jobs and Redis so the mobile client never waits on the source system
Sustained high-volume inserts through Redis job queues and Node.js worker threads running in parallel, with backpressure so a slow write never stalls ingestion
Built the REST API in Node.js, Express, TypeScript and TypeORM, serving the mobile client paginated, filterable and sortable data
Containerised the service with Docker and ran it on AWS ECS Fargate, with the whole environment defined in Terraform
Integrated Okta for authentication, Zod for request validation, and Swagger for API documentation the client team worked against
Shipped Datadog logging and monitoring through FireLens sidecars, so failures in the ingestion pipeline were visible rather than silent
Onboarded junior developers, reviewed their pull requests, and coordinated delivery in JIRA

hashlogics.title: Senior Software Developer
hashlogics.summary: Led delivery teams across four products, from AI product matching to serverless compliance platforms.
responsibilities: Led development teams on multiple high-impact projects including CivaSource, PlayerTotals, and a real-time gaming platform
Directed a team building a site safety and compliance platform, moving monolithic APIs to serverless microservices on AWS Lambda with infrastructure as code in Terraform
Built AI-driven product matching, authentication and product management services in Python and FastAPI, backed by PostgreSQL and Redis
Architected micro-frontends so several teams could ship into one product without blocking each other
Kept high-volume pipelines moving with Redis queues for concurrent scraping, matching and real-time processing
Delivered real-time player statistics on Node.js, TypeScript and MongoDB, with scheduled extraction jobs feeding live dashboards
Built a trading education CRM in Python, Flask, Django and React, covering lead capture through to the sales team workflow
Ran AWS deployments and CI/CD, and took part in estimation, sprint planning and client-facing technical calls
Named Employee of the Month for delivery and team leadership

skupreme.title: Software Engineer
skupreme.summary: Front-end work on the web dashboard of a US supply chain and inventory product.
responsibilities: Extended the web dashboard of a supply chain and inventory product used by its operations team
Built responsive, accessible interfaces in Next.js and TypeScript using modern React patterns and component composition
Integrated the dashboard against existing REST APIs, handling loading, empty and error states properly
Improved perceived performance by trimming re-renders and deferring non-critical data
Worked with a fully remote team across time zones and kept the codebase to its review standards

homeats.title: Software Engineer
homeats.summary: Full-stack work on the dashboard and APIs of an online healthy food marketplace.
responsibilities: Extended the web dashboard of an online healthy food marketplace, covering menus, orders and vendor management
Built the front end in Next.js and TypeScript, and the REST APIs behind it in Node.js
Modelled and queried the data layer so list and detail views stayed fast as the catalogue grew
Maintained Swagger documentation so the wider team and mobile developers could work against the API
Handled responsive layouts down to small phone widths, which is where most of the traffic was

memberhood.title: Software Engineer
memberhood.summary: Built the backend and storefront of a multi-merchant membership commerce platform with Stripe.
responsibilities: Built the backend of a membership commerce platform on KeystoneJS, GraphQL and MongoDB, serving multiple independent merchants from one storefront
Integrated Stripe for subscription payments, merchant onboarding and payout flows
Implemented webhook handling with signature verification and idempotent processing, so a retried event never charged twice
Implemented the Next.js and TypeScript storefront against both GraphQL and REST APIs
Coordinated staged deployments across environments and kept the CI/CD pipelines running
Worked across time zones with an international team, in English, on a daily delivery cadence

gulzarsoft.title: Associate Software Engineer
gulzarsoft.summary: First professional role: full-stack JavaScript across several client web applications.
responsibilities: First professional role, working across the stack in JavaScript on client web applications
Built responsive web applications in React.js and Node.js, both independently and as part of a team
Wrote REST APIs for filtering, search, pagination and database management over MySQL and MongoDB
Built a customer loyalty product where points convert into mobile top-up codes, including the payment step
Built a car search front end over scraped listings, with a filter form that stayed fast on large result sets
Delivered in sprints, took part in agile planning, and learned code review as a habit rather than a gate
